requirements.statement: m_we writes one 16-bit input word at m_addr on the external rising edge; the input RAM has no reset initialization.

s_re requests a registered read of the 32-bit output word selected by s_addr; the value updates after the rising edge and holds while s_re is low. rst does not clear the output register; disabled reads retain the previous value even while reset is high.

The fixed default profile is DIVISOR=5, N=16, Q=8, ADDR_WIDTH=5, DATA_WIDTH=16, DEPTH=32. The transform runs continuously and exposes no start, ready, or done handshake. rst is asynchronous active-high; neither input nor output RAM is initialized by reset.

After addresses 0 through 31 have each been written once and the inputs remain stable for at least 20 external rising edges, the 32 output words match the public 32-point fixed-point forward-transform contract in natural frequency order.
